name: rocketHasStaged
description: Indicates if staging has occurred, if greater than zero.

name: stage1fuelConsumed
description: Indicates how much fuel has been expended from the first stage; used only if stagedFlag == 0. Used to linearly interpolate mass properties (CG, mass, moments of inertia) between full (0 fuel expended) and empty (all stage 1 fuel expended) reference values for each of these outputs.

name: stage2fuelConsumed
description: Indicates how much fuel has been expended from the second stage. Used to linearly interpolate mass properties (CG, mass, moments of inertia) between full (0 fuel expended) and empty (all stage 2 fuel expended) reference values for each of these outputs. Using a value other than 0 while stagedFlag == 0 will result in undefined results.

name: fullVehicleMomentReferenceCenter
description: Location of the moment reference center for the full (two-stage) vehicle, given in meters and measured from the nose of the vehicle; positive aft.

name: secondStageMomentReferenceCenter
description: Location of the moment reference center for the second-stage only vehicle, given in meters and measured from the nose of the vehicle; positive aft.

name: stage1XCGRange
description: Range of locations of center-of-mass of two-stage rocket prior to staging; determined by subtracting S1Burnout_XCG from Liftoff_XCG values given in REF01

name: stage2XCGRange
description: Range of values of the center-of-mass of the second stage; determined by subtracting S2Burnout_XCG from S2Ignite_XCG values given in REF01

name: stage1FuelCapacity
description: Fuel capacity of first stage; determined by subtracting S1Burnout_Mass from Liftoff_Mass values given in REF01

name: stage2FuelCapacity
description: Fuel capacity of second stage; determined by subtracting S2Burnout_Mass from S2Ignite_Mass values given in REF01

name: stage1IxxRange
description: Range of values of Ixx of first stage; determined by subtracting S1Burnout_Ixx from Liftoff_Ixx values given in REF01

name: stage2IxxRange
description: Range of values of Ixx of second stage; determined by subtracting S2Burnout_Ixx from S2Ignite_Ixx values given in REF01

name: stage1IyyRange
description: Range of values of Iyy and Izz of first stage; determined by subtracting S1Burnout_Iyy from Liftoff_Iyy values given in REF01

name: stage2IyyRange
description: Range of values of Iyy and Izz of second stage; determined by subtracting S2Burnout_Iyy from S2Ignite_Iyy values given in REF01

name: vrsPositionOfCM_X
description: Position of the center of mass along the X-axis of the vehicle reference system (meters, positive aft). Determined by linearly interpolating either the two-stage rocket, or the just the second stage if stagedFlag > 0, between full and empty fuel states, depending on the appropriate fuel fraction value.

name: stage1FuelRemainingFrac
description: Fraction of fuel remaining in stage 1, 0-1 (1 is full)

name: stage2FuelRemainingFrac
description: Fraction of fuel remaining in stage 2, 0-1 (1 is full)

name: bodyMomentOfInertia_Roll
description: Rolling moment of inertia about the body X axis. Determined by linearly interpolating either the two-stage rocket, or the just the second stage if stagedFlag > 0, between full and empty fuel states, depending on the appropriate fuel fraction value.

name: bodyMomentOfInertia_Pitch
description: Pitching moment of inertia about the body Y axis Determined by linearly interpolating either the two-stage rocket, or the just the second stage if stagedFlag > 0, between full and empty fuel states, depending on the appropriate fuel fraction value.

name: bodyMomentOfInertia_Yaw
description: Yawing moment of inertia about the body Z axis. Identical to the pitching moment of inertia (XIYY).

name: bodyProductOfInertia_ZX
description: Cross-product of inertia in the body X-Z plane

name: bodyProductOfInertia_XY
description: Cross-product of inertia in the body X-Y plane

name: bodyProductOfInertia_YZ
description: Cross-product of inertia in the body Y-Z plane

name: totalMass
description: Total mass of vehicle Determined by linearly interpolating either the two-stage rocket, or the just the second stage if stagedFlag > 0, between full and empty fuel states, depending on the appropriate fuel fraction value.

name: vrsPositionOfMrc
description: Longitudinal location of the moment reference center in meters back from the nose of the vehicle; positive aft. Value changes based on value of staged flag.

name: bodyPositionOfCmWrtMrc_X
description: Longitudinal location of the center of mass relative to the nose of the vehicle; increasingly positive as the CM moves fwd as fuel is expended.

name: bodyPositionOfCmWrtMrc_Y
description: Longitudinal location of the center of mass relative to the centerline of the vehicle; positive if the CM is to the right of the centerline

name: bodyPositionOfCmWrtMrc_Z
description: Vertical location of the center of mass relative to the centerline of the vehicle; positive if the CM is below the centerline
